## CollectionReference interface

A deferred reference to a collection.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface CollectionReference<T, R extends string = string> extends Resolvable<readonly T[]>
```

**Extends:** [Resolvable](./contracts.resolvable.md)<!-- -->&lt;readonly T\[\]&gt;

## Remarks

Membership is determined when the reference is resolved. Resolving yields an array that may be empty; an invalid range fails with an invalid-selection error, never with an empty result.
